title: Prehistoric Times and Digital Image
content: Thanks to the readers ofPrehistoric Timesfor votingImaginative Realismthe "Favorite Prehistoric Animal Book of 2009."Also, I really appreciate thereview from Digital Image Magazine, which noted that the book is not just for fantasy artists who use traditional materials."There are a few pages devoted to traditional materials and methods, but most of the book contains information any artist, digital or otherwise, will find helpful. Even if you’re not painting fantasy images, you’ll find useful techniques for composition, altering lighting, color schemes, focus, directing the eye, telling a story, and so forth."Check out Digital Imagehomepagewith a cool feature on usingchiaroscuro in portraits.Note to aspiring and established paleoartists: Prehistoric Times is a great venue for getting your work seen. Information about submitting your artworkhere.
